title: Ahinsa
overview: A chance encounter between two widows who lost their husbands and sons to violence sets the story going. Birju (Sunil Dutt) has received the highest military honour in battle. He returns home to his village and promptly becomes an outlaw leader (dacoit). He crosses swords with a vicious dacoit called Raka.

songs.title: Main Ne Tan Man De Dala
Mujhe Dena Re Badhai Gaon Walo
songs.singers: Asha Bhosle, Mohammed Rafi, Anand Kumar C., Badri Prasad
